title: Once Generated, Ranked: End-to-End Generative Slate Recommendation with Unified Semantic-Collaborative IDs
abstract: arXiv:2608.17613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Slate recommendation treats a slate rather than an individual item as the recommendation unit, requiring joint optimization of item interactions and slate utility. Existing approaches typically separate candidate generation from ranking and restrict optimization to retrieved candidates. Generative recommendation with Semantic IDs (SIDs) offers a path to end-to-end recommendation, but existing SID construction often lacks recommendation-aware semantics and effective local collaborative signals, while next-token prediction is misaligned with slate-level objectives. We propose OGR, an end-to-end framework that directly generates ordered slates-"Once Generated, Ranked." OGR first introduces TUSID, which adaptively fuses item-specific semantic and local collaborative information into hierarchical SIDs. translated_title: 一次生成，即排序：基于统一语义-协同ID的端到端生成式推荐列表
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17613v1 公告类型：新 摘要：推荐列表将整个列表而非单个物品作为推荐单元，要求对物品交互和列表效用进行联合优化。现有方法通常将候选生成与排序分离，并将优化限制在检索到的候选项上。基于语义ID（SIDs）的生成式推荐提供了一条端到端推荐的路径，但现有的SID构建往往缺乏推荐感知的语义和有效的局部协同信号，而下一个词元预测与列表级目标不一致。我们提出OGR，一个直接生成有序列表的端到端框架——“一次生成，即排序”。OGR首先引入TUSID，它将物品特定语义和局部协同信息自适应融合到层次化SID中。然后，它使用列表级偏好规划和流水线位置感知SID解码来建模全局偏好和物品间依赖关系。
tldr: 本文提出OGR框架，通过统一语义-协同ID和列表级解码，实现端到端直接生成有序推荐列表，解决了现有生成式推荐中语义构建和排序对齐的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OGR, an end-to-end framework that directly generates ordered recommendation slates via unified semantic-collaborative IDs and list-wise decoding, addressing limitations in semantic construction and ranking alignment of existing generative recommendation.
